nodes.description: Address of the contract admin, set once in the constructor to msg.sender; gates minting.
Private total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
Private mapping of account balances, read and written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping of owner-to-spender allowances, written by _approve.
Token name storage, set in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol storage, set in the ERC20 constructor.
Deploys GNX token: sets admin to msg.sender and mints 1 billion units to the deployer.
Public minting entry point restricted by require(msg.sender == admin); mints arbitrary amounts.
Internal supply-increase routine that credits _balances[account] and increases _totalSupply.
Public ERC20 transfer from msg.sender to recipient via _transfer.
Public transfer using the allowance mechanism; reads allowance, checks it, then decrements it in an unchecked block.
Public allowance setter delegating to _approve.
Adds addedValue to the caller's allowance for spender.
Subtracts subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for spender after a require check.
Internal balance-movement routine performing balance checks and unchecked subtraction.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address validation.
Internal supply-decrease routine that debits _balances[account] and decreases _totalSupply.
View function returning _balances[account].
View function returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Internal helper returning msg.sender; used by ERC20 entry points.
Caller-controlled address used for admin assignment, the admin mint gate and all ERC20 entry points.
Access-control check in mint(); the only guard preventing arbitrary addresses from minting tokens.
Privileged mint invocation in GNXNative.mint that can inflate supply without cap or timelock.
Unchecked currentAllowance - amount / subtractedValue arithmetic on allowances.
Arithmetic _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue computed with checked math.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to admin, giving the deployer permanent minting authority.
Constructor writes the privileged admin state variable.
Constructor calls _mint to issue the initial 1 billion supply.
mint() executes the require(msg.sender == admin) guard.
The untrusted caller address is the value compared against admin in the access-control check.
Only after the admin check does execution reach the privileged _mint call.
mint() body invokes the token-issuing operation.
The mint operation delegates to ERC20._mint to update balances and supply.
Mint recipient parameter flows into the privileged _mint invocation.
Caller-supplied mint amount flows into _mint and increases total supply.
_mint account parameter determines which balance is credited.
_mint amount parameter is added to balances and total supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_mint credits _balances[account] by amount.
transfer() delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transfer recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
transferFrom sender parameter selects the allowance owner and debited balance.
transferFrom recipient parameter receives the transferred tokens.
transferFrom amount parameter is checked against and subtracted from the allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] into the currentAllowance local.
The allowance snapshot is subtracted inside the unchecked block.
The unchecked subtraction result is written back through _approve.
approve() delegates allowance writing to _approve.
approve spender parameter becomes the allowance key.
approve amount parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
increaseAllowance computes existing allowance plus addedValue.
The increased allowance is persisted via _approve.
increaseAllowance spender parameter selects the allowance slot.
addedValue parameter is summed into the allowance.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance spender parameter selects the allowance slot.
subtractedValue parameter is deducted from the allowance.
_transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in _balances.
_transfer loads _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_burn debits _balances[account] under an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
balanceOf account parameter is used as the mapping key.
allowance owner parameter is used as the outer mapping key.
allowance spender parameter is used as the inner mapping key.
transfer resolves the caller through _msgSender().
transferFrom resolves the caller through _msgSender().
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender into privileged allowance logic.

normalization_plan.reason: _recipient is a call parameter that only exists to be forwarded into GNXNative.mint's privileged _mint call.
_amount is a call parameter that only exists to size the mint performed by GNXNative.mint.
recipient is an ERC20.transfer parameter and has no independent semantics.
amount is an ERC20.transfer parameter and has no independent semantics.
sender is an ERC20.transferFrom parameter used only for the allowance lookup.
recipient is an ERC20.transferFrom parameter used only for the token movement.
amount is an ERC20.transferFrom parameter consumed by the unchecked allowance subtraction.
spender is an ERC20.approve parameter used only as the allowance key.
amount is an ERC20.approve parameter used only as the allowance value.
spender is an ERC20.increaseAllowance parameter selecting the allowance slot.
addedValue is an ERC20.increaseAllowance parameter summed into the allowance.
spender is an ERC20.decreaseAllowance parameter selecting the allowance slot.
subtractedValue is an ERC20.decreaseAllowance parameter deducted from the allowance.
account is an ERC20.balanceOf parameter used only as the mapping key.
owner is an ERC20.allowance parameter used only as the outer mapping key.
spender is an ERC20.allowance parameter used only as the inner mapping key.
account is an ERC20._mint parameter used only to pick the credited balance.
amount is an ERC20._mint parameter that drives the supply arithmetic.
currentAllowance is a transient local inside ERC20.transferFrom feeding the unchecked subtraction.
senderBalance is a transient local inside ERC20._transfer used only for the balance check and debit.
